project.name: tokenist-optimizer
project.displayName: Tokenist — Open-Source Local Token Optimizer Layer
project.description: Open-Source Local Token Optimizer Layer for AI Agents

architecture.type: Standalone Local Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
architecture.transport: stdio JSON-RPC (primary), HTTP server mode (optional via CLI flags)

optimizers.name: PageRank Dependency Centrality Ranker
optimizers.mechanism: Power iteration graph analysis ranks imports. High PageRank -> normal tier, low PageRank -> aggressive tier.

optimizers.name: Greedy Token Budget Allocator
optimizers.mechanism: Escalates tiers greedily from normal -> medium -> aggressive -> omitted to meet maxTokenBudget.

optimizers.name: BM25 + ONNX Hybrid Semantic Search
optimizers.mechanism: Ranks files by query relevance using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings + BM25 keyword matching.

optimizers.name: CacheAligner Prompt Stabilizer
optimizers.mechanism: Relocates dynamic tokens (UUIDs, timestamps) to end of prompt to maximize LLM prefix caching.

optimizers.name: SmartCrusher Non-Code Content Compressor
optimizers.mechanism: Crushes raw JSON API responses, build logs, and stack traces by 60-90%.

optimizers.name: SchemaCompressor MCP Tool Optimizer
optimizers.mechanism: Shortens MCP tool descriptions and parameter schemas to save context window tokens.

decision_engine.scoring: PageRank centrality + BM25/ONNX cosine similarity score + Greedy Token Budget Escalation

pricing.calculationType: Estimated / Simulated (based on raw vs compressed character length / 3.5)

savings.formula: rawTokens = text.length / 3.5, compressedTokens = compressed.length / 3.5, savedUSD = (rawTokens - compressedTokens) * rate

cache.invalidation: SHA-256 content hash matching or file mtime modification check

routing.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED (Optimizer operates entirely on local context window contents before model invocation)

database.persistence: NONE (No RDBMS or NoSQL database used)

mockedComponents: Git command fallback when git binary absent

limitations: No multi-tenant authentication or workspace access control
No persistence database (relies on flat JSON files)
No model or cost-aware LLM provider routing
Estimated token and dollar savings rather than provider billing reconciliation
No automated LLM response quality scoring engine (evals)
Requires local Node.js environment or container setup
known_issues: CLI execution in sub-shell environments subject to OS-level child process permission flags

tokenistt_integration.architectureMismatch: Tokenist is a local context compression layer; Tokenistt FinOps is a centralized cloud gateway with organization multi-tenancy, credit ledgers, and API key management.
tokenistt_integration.gap: Tokenist currently lacks HTTP authorization headers, tenant ID context propagation, and ledger sync webhooks.

recommended_integration_point.pipeline: Client App -> Tokenistt Gateway Auth & Org Policy Check -> Tokenist AST Compression & Context Optimizers -> LLM Provider -> Transaction Ledger & Billing

mustHave: Add HTTP Middleware authentication adapter for Tokenistt JWT/API Key validation
Tenant-isolate cache keys by appending tenantId and orgId prefix to .tokenist/cache.json keys
Export telemetry ledger events directly to Tokenistt FinOps Postgres transaction ledger
shouldHave: Integrate Tokenistt Gateway model pricing table dynamically instead of static PRICING_MAP
Expose Tokenist compression tools via REST API endpoint in Tokenistt Gateway
niceToHave: A/B quality evaluation feedback loop between compressed prompts and LLM completion accuracy
